description.narrative:
SALAR and its subsidiary SKL International will during 2016 and 2017 conduct a feasibility study in preparation of a possible future programme aiming at strengthening local institutions in Jordan, Lebanon and Turkey int their capacity as providers of basic services. The end target group for such an intervention would be vulnerabale groups in these countries, including refugees from Syria.
The study is anticipated to culminate in a detailed proposal for a sub-regional programme with a conflict-sensitive approach, operating on national policy level in paralell with the local level, involve a varied set of local institutions and stakeholders as well as integrate human rights- and gender perspectives.

SKL skall under 2016-17 genomföra en förstudie inför eventuellt framtida program syftandes till att stärka lokala institutioner i Jordanien, Libanon och Turkiet i egenskap av leverantörer av lokala samhällstjänster. Den yttersta målgruppen för en sådan insats skulle vara utsatta grupper i dessa länder, inklusive flyktingar från Syrien.
Studien ska mynna i ett detaljerat förslag till sub-regionalt program som ska anta ett en konfliktkänslig ansats, verka på nationell policy-nivå paralellt med den lokala nivån, inbegripa en varierad uppsättning lokala myndigheter och intressenter, integrera MR- och jämställdhetsperspektiv.

sector.narrative: Multisector aid for basic social services

description.narrative: The contribution aimed at producing a feasibility study assessing the preconditions for SALAR to engage in development programming in Syria's neighbouring countries within the areas envisaged in Sweden's Regional Strategy for the Syria Crisis. The report presented the findings of the research work that was conducted during the activity period. The contribution is of preparatory character. Its aim was to provide a feasibility study with proposals for future intervention aimed at strengthening local institutional capacity to deliver basic services.SKL and Sida used the report as a base to prepare an inception phase of a larger intervention aimed to support local authorities and communities closely affected by the Syrian crisis.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
